data.summary: The Google reviews show significant red flags for potential inauthenticity. The positive reviews are clustered in time, repetitive in language, and heavily focused on one individual (Chad). The single negative review is detailed and credible, describing a failure to fix the stated problem. The extremely high rating with very few total reviews is suspicious. While there are some authentic signals, the pattern leans toward possible review manipulation or selective solicitation.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted same month (3 months ago)
Repetitive, generic praise across reviews (e.g., 'A+ in professionalism', 'first-rate customer service')
Lack of specific project details in many 5-star reviews
Owner/manager name (Chad) mentioned in nearly every positive review, creating a 'personality cult' pattern
Very low total review count (26) for a 4.9 rating, suggesting possible review solicitation

negative_evidence: Negative review implies work did not fix the leak, suggesting potential warranty/guarantee issue

authentic_signals: One detailed negative review with specific timeline and problem description
Some positive reviews mention specific individuals (Darwin, Anthony) and long-term relationships (10 years)
complaint_patterns: Work not solving the stated problem
Focus on upsell/other work instead of requested repair
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews found. No other platform ratings to compare.

reviews.text:
I hired DLV Roofing Dallas, LLC to repair a persistent leak over a small area of my entryway—the metal roof over a 4x4 foot section that is separate from the main roof. Despite clear communication about the specific leak, the company ended up focusing on other potential issues, changing all the screws to larger rubber ones and sealing a few spots. All of this was done during the dry season, so I had to wait until the first rain to see any results.

Unfortunately, when it finally rained, the roof leaked at exactly the same spot as my original complaint. DLV sent someone out again to reseal more areas. Still, after a few months and another heavy rain, the leak returned in the very same spot. Over two years, I have paid nearly $9,000 for repeated visits to address this 4x4 area, but the fundamental problem remains unsolved.

It feels like seeing a doctor for an eye problem and having your leg treated while your vision remains unchanged. To make matters worse, DLV Roofing has stopped responding to my emails and texts altogether. The roof leak for which I initially contacted them still persists, with no resolution or ongoing support. I cannot recommend this company based on my experience—two years, multiple visits, and a significant financial investment later, I am left with the same issue I started with and no answers from the business.

P.S: the second picture around the chimney, i flew my drone to check their work, i have no other way to get up there.
reviews.author: Vishal Bagchi

reviews.text: Chad Mitchell is an A+ in professionalism and knowledge of the roofing industry.  Chad and his entourage were amazing and nothing beats the first-rate customer service!  They took care of my family from day 1!  Chad was such a pleasure to work with.  We had issues with our insurance inspectors estimates and Chad’s team promptly showed them their faults.  Our roof, trim and gutters were replaced and looks fantastic!  I highly recommend DLV Roofing to anyone in need of roofing services as they are reliable, skilled, and genuinely customer-focused!  We highly recommend them to anyone!!
reviews.author: Eddie G

reviews.text:
I recently had my entire roof replaced by DLV Roofing, and couldn’t be happier with the results. Our project manager, Chad Mitchell, receives an A+ in professionalism and knowledge of the roofing industry. He was present and available throughout the entire process, making sure we always knew what to expect. Communication was excellent from the initial inspection to the final walk through. The crew was courteous and punctual, arriving on time each day, working efficiently and showing great respect for my home and property. They protected our landscaping, maintaining a clean work area every day. As a result, they we were able to finish the project in two days.
The new roof looks fantastic! Chad recommended the Certain Teed Climate Flex Class 4 shingle because of its high quality and impact resistant materials. This provided us with the peace of mind knowing it was installed with precision and care. I highly recommend DLV Roofing to anyone seeking a reliable and quality roofing company that will deliver top-tier workmanship using premium materials.
reviews.author: Patty Ilaoa DeMent
